summary_en: NATOCO completed the acquisition of all shares of Toupe Co., Ltd., making it a wholly-owned subsidiary. The acquisition involved 30,801,738 shares and was finalized on November 2, 2026, following the initial announcement on May 11, 2026.
title_en: Completion Notice of Stock Acquisition of Toupe Co., Ltd. (Making It a Wholly-Owned Subsidiary)
translation_en_brief: NATOCO CO., LTD. announced the completion of its acquisition of all shares of Toupe Co., Ltd. on November 2, 2026, making Toupe a wholly-owned subsidiary. The acquisition involved 30,801,738 shares, representing 100% ownership. Toupe, established in 1919 and based in Sakai, Osaka, manufactures and sells paint products. The acquisition was initially announced on May 11, 2026, and the completion represents the finalization of the previously disclosed transaction. Following the completion, Taiichi Kasuya took office as Representative Director and Chairman, with Itoshi Matsuda continuing as Representative Director and President. The company stated that as of the disclosure date, there would be no revision to consolidated earnings forecasts for the fiscal year ending October 2026 due to this transaction.
